messages.content: and meet him And ask him whats the reason of these arms Tell him Ill send Duke Edmund to the Tower And Somerset we will commit thee thither Until his army be dismissed from him SOMERSET My lord Ill yield myself to prison willingly Or unto death to do my country good KING HENRY In any case be not too rough in terms For he is fierce and cannot brook hard language BUCKINGHAM I will my lord and doubt not so to deal As all things shall redound unto your good KING HENRY Come wife lets in and learn to govern better For yet may England curse my wretched reign Flourish Exeunt
